title: Austin Runoff Election Results Finalized
meeting_type: Austin City Council Special Called Meeting
summary:
*   A special meeting was called to finalize the city's recent election process.
*   The council's main action was to officially approve and certify the vote counts from the December 16 runoff election.
*   This crucial step legally confirmed the winners of various city races, paving the way for new terms to begin.

Tuesday, December 30, 2014 
The Austin City Council will convene at 10:00 AM on

301 W. Second Street, Austin, TX 
 
 
Mayor Lee Leffingwell 
Mayor Pro Tem Sheryl Cole
